representations.date.ecma:invalid_date: Valid dates are Timestamp. Invalid dates are records with __lash_brand=(date.ecma,invalid_date) and __lash_built. Source: lash-ext-date-ecma/src/lib.rs timestamp native and date_value.
representations.regex.ecma:reg_exp: Record with pattern Text, canonical flags Text, lastIndex Number and exact brand stamp. Native exec returns match data and next lastIndex without mutating its input. Sources: lash-ext-regex-ecma/src/functions.rs reg_exp; docs/kernel/design.md section 3.
representations.stamp: Helper-created branded records carry __lash_brand as (package, type) and __lash_built as exact constructor FunctionId bytes. Authored TypeScript template records carry only __lash_brand and have no constructor stamp. No representation compatibility across changed constructors is implied. Sources: docs/kernel/design.md section 3; lash-kernel-lib/src/brand.rs; lash-dialect-typescript/src/lower/expressions.rs.

representations.typescript:bigint: Explicit TypeScript BigInts are immutable tuples (ts.bigint, Int), created by literals, constructors, arithmetic and declared bigint inputs. Untagged incoming kernel integers have JavaScript binary64 Number semantics; host copy-out unwraps tagged BigInts as exact Ints. Sources: lash-dialect-typescript/src/lower/expressions.rs; lash-ext-ts-helpers/src/helpers/bigint.kernel; lash-ext-ts-helpers/src/helpers/core.kernel.
